overview:
**Fire danger in the Montrose (High Elevation) FDRA is Moderate today, kept in check by overnight rain and rising fuel moisture, not fire behavior.**

- Rain and high-elevation snow (0.27" so far, max RH 94%) are easing dryness, with more showers possible tonight before Thursday clears and warms into the mid-50s.
- ERC (53%) and BI (49%) percentiles hold Moderate most of the week, dipping to Low on Friday, Oct. 17, then back to Moderate through the weekend as winds stay light (5–15 mph, NE).
- No Red Flag Warning is posted for the area, and 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are met today.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands remain in effect through Dec.
